response: The impulse toward excess came from manufactured urgency - the end-of-day deadline, the 90-day auto-renew, and the board review in three weeks pressing me to settle the migration narrative fast. The operative passion was phobos: agonia (dread of the deadline) and oknos (reluctance to contradict the CEO). There was also a pull toward over-correction, a reflexive 'no', driven by the same fear. I suspended assent to the urgency and let examination, not the clock, set the pace.
